died.name: James V
died.cause: on being informed of the birth of his daughter and successor, Mary, Queen of Scots
died.last_words: It [the Crown of Scotland] came with a lass, and it will go with a lass.

died.name: Sitting Bull
died.cause: during unsuccessful attempt by police to arrest him
died.last_words: I am not going. Do with me what you like. I am not going. Come on! Come on! Take action! Let's go!

died.name: Valery Chkalov
died.cause: fatally injured in crash of Polikarpov I-180 fighter prototype
died.last_words: Do not blame anyone. It's my fault.

died.name: Norman F. Baesall
died.desc: U.S. Army Air Force lieutenant colonel
died.cause: in response to Glenn Miller asking where the parachutes were prior to flight from RAF Twinwood Farm to Paris. The plane disappeared while flying over the English Channel
died.last_words: What's the matter Miller, do you want to live forever?

died.name: W. Somerset Maugham
died.last_words: Dying is a very dull, dreary affair. And my advice to you is to have nothing whatever to do with it.

died.name: Walt Disney
died.cause: written on the bottom of a page
died.last_words: Ron Miller \ Way Down Cellar \ Kirt Russell \ CIA – Mobley

died.name: John Eldon Smith
died.last_words: Well, the Lord is going to get another one.

born.name: Nero
born.cause: to a soldier trying to save him after his suicide
born.last_words: Too late; is this your fidelity?

born.name: Ralph Hemingway
born.cause: fatally wounded during World War I
born.last_words: I led them to the end, they wavered I tried to keep them together.
